tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (10.4:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: soft-teal
tokens.usage: Primary accent, calming professionalism ║. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.stat-icon.teal`, `.stat-trend`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: warm-beige
tokens.usage: Secondary surfaces, spa warmth ║. Used as background on `.stat-icon.beige`; border on `td`.

tokens.name: rose-gold
tokens.usage: Luxury accent, aspirational elegance ║. Used as text on `.stat-icon.rose`, `.status-scheduled`. 1.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Typography, sophisticated contrast ║. Used as text on `body`, `.nav-link`, `.btn-primary`. 10.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: soft-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.timeline-description`. 1.7:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: accent-teal-dark
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-icon.beige`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: success-green
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-icon.green`, `.status-completed`. 1.9:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.card-action:hover`, `.timeline-marker`, `.patient-avatar`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stat-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `.stat-card`, `.content-card`, `.table-container`; background on `.stat-icon.teal`, `tr:hover`, `.status-active`; shadow/glow on `.footer`, `.form-input:focus`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.btn-primary` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.
